title: Asahina Mafuyu — Cat-Eared Guide〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Vacant Classroom

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There we are...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That should be all the gloves and hats we're going to need.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I was also able to borrow some cans of bug spray, so that just leaves—)
Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I brought those garbage bags you asked for!
The custodian gave me a lot, so we should be all set☆

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, Otori.
Then, let's put these in that box over there.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, got it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Humhumhummm♪
Pulling weeds, pulling weeds, it's so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She seems as energetic as ever...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We'll be getting the snacks and drinks on the day of the weed pulling, right?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. The teachers were going to get them for us, but the head priest was kind enough to tell the business owners in the local shopping district about what we're doing, and they've decided to give us some assistance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, even everyone from the shopping district is on board now?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That means we've really gotta make sure we pull lots of weeds and put on a fun test of courage☆

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, it does.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's make the most of every minute we have left☆
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, we seem to have everything we need, so let's stop here for today. Thank you for all your hard work, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're welcome! We both worked really hard today!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Anyway, shall we start heading out?
We can bundle everything up and—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Asahina, actually!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We don't have to leave for a few more minutes, so can you tell me what you think about my monster acting?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Your monster acting?
Oh, for the test of courage...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes! I've been thinking lots and lots about how to play a cute monster!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I told Tsukasa and the others about what we're doing, and they suggested that coming up with a little story would make things easier...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, we came up with a short story called “The Spirits of the Colorful Haunted Mansion”...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: “The Spirits of the Colorful Haunted Mansion”...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's about people stumbling upon a mansion deep within some dark mountains. The resident spirits start by scaring them a little, but they end up becoming friends and partying together later on☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Each room is home to a different spirit, and each of them scares people in its own unique way.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I play a pink monster that lives in a pink room☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hinomori plays a snow-white yuki-onna who haunts a white room. And Honami...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She came up with a story to help her get into character...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She's willing to go that far.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The test of courage is supposed to be sort of an added bonus after the weed pulling. More to the point, it's just something we have to do as class representatives...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna jump out and shout, but not in a scary way. My goal is to make it feel like my monster wants to play with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, but! I have a feeling that doing lots of cute poses and stuff will help make things a lot more fun for everyone! Also...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She wants everyone to have fun...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't really understand that feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, all the rooms in the mansion combine together... And make a rainbow appear in the sky!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What did you think?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I thought your story was lovely.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sure that everyone will smile when they see you as that monster, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa, Nene, Rui and I thought really long and hard about this story and my monster!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, but we actually came up with a few different variations!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: During our discussion, we came up with lots and lots of fun ideas!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Would you like to hear them?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The bell's about to ring.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't mind staying to listen for a bit longer, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I am interested in hearing these other ideas...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But you still haven't shown me how you're going to play your monster.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
R-R-R-R-Right...!
U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, I'll start with the part where I jump out! Watch and tell me what you think...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Okay, she's finally going to show me.)
